style_guide.name: Moonlit Forest RPG Asset Pack Style Guide
style_guide.visual_style: hand-painted 2D game art, orthographic or subtle three-quarter game view
style_guide.typography: legible post-processed labels, clean sans-serif, high contrast
style_guide.negative_prompt: gritty realism, photorealism, harsh shadows, noisy detail, cluttered compositions
notes: Keep all assets cohesive for a small prototype. Use clear silhouettes, simple readable shapes, and consistent moonlit forest village motifs with animal companions.
